constraints: Applies to all 4D View Pro areas initialized after this call during the session; can be called multiple times in the same session to set up different configurations.
By default, if this command is never called, no method call is allowed in 4D View Pro areas, unless 4D's generic SET ALLOWED METHODS command was previously used (compatibility fallback).
Using an unauthorized method in a 4D View Pro formula prints a #NAME? error in the area.
Each <functionName> key in methodObj must not contain space characters, and its .method property (an existing 4D project method name) is mandatory.
methodObj.<functionName>.parameters[].type is optional except when at least one parameter is of collection type, in which case declaring type is mandatory for that function.
When a parameter's type is omitted, the value is sent with its native type, except Date/Time values which are sent as an object; when type is 'Is object', the object is sent in a .value property.
methodObj.<functionName>.maxParams may be set higher than the length of the parameters collection to declare optional parameters with a default type.
